name: resource-max-segment-matched
title: Maximum resource segment · matched RNS policy
summary: Repeat maximum-efficient resource transfers with both endpoint interfaces configured for RNS's 10 Mbps / 16 KiB policy.
notes: Controlled policy comparison: identical workload and protocol with both implementations configured for the stock RNS bitrate and MTU tier.
description: The resource-max-segment workload repeated with both real initiator and responder interfaces explicitly configured for 10 Mbps. That policy selects the 16,384-byte interface MTU tier on both stacks. Transfers still use the normal encrypted, hash-proved, application-acknowledged resource path; this is the policy-matched counterpart to the default-policy result.
conformance: Every sent transfer settles, receives its ordered application acknowledgement, and is received with exact application-byte totals and zero failures; the receiver hash-proves each resource before settlement.
